title: kbmon's ask and claim times show in local time or say UTC
goal: Each wall-clock time kbmon prints for an ask, claim or landing (mon_coord builds 'since YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' in UTC today) is either local time or carries 'UTC', so 'since 2026-10-27 22:39' is not read as local 22:39 when it was 23:39 local. The form is UTC with the suffix, the same in every panel.

run: import re,subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--status','coord','--timeout','60'],capture_output=True,text=True);bad=[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if re.search(r'since [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(?! UTC)',l)];sys.exit(r.returncode not in (0,1) or bool(bad))
